name: heuristic-review
description: Nielsen heuristic evaluation of a live web app: one expert agent inspects every screen in scope against the ten usability heuristics under forced enumeration, three synthetic rater personas judge each finding's usability impact, and you get a prioritized findings table (business impact × usability impact, with rater convergence). Three scope modes: single screen, specific flow, or whole-site crawl. Drives the browser via Playwright MCP.
